use default

power(base: int, exponent: int) -> long is
    let result mut = 1L

    for _ in 1::exponent do
        result = result * cast(base)
    od

    result
si

digit_counts(value: long) -> LIST[int] is
    let counts = LIST()

    for _ in 0::9 do
        counts.add(0)
    od

    let remaining mut = value

    while remaining > 0L do
        let digit = cast int(remaining % 10L)

        counts[digit] = counts[digit] + 1
        remaining = remaining / 10L
    od

    counts
si

multisets(width: int, lowest: int, chosen: LIST[int]) -> Pipe[LIST[int]] is
    if chosen.count == width then
        yield chosen
    else
        for digit in lowest::9 do
            let extended = LIST(chosen)

            extended.add(digit)

            yield in multisets(width, digit, extended)
        od
    fi
si

own_sums(width: int) -> Pipe[long] is
    for combination in multisets(width, 0, LIST()) do
        let total mut = 0L

        for digit in combination do
            total = total + power(digit, width)
        od

        if "{total}".length == width then
            let wanted = digit_counts(total)
            let held = LIST()

            for _ in 0::9 do
                held.add(0)
            od

            for digit in combination do
                held[digit] = held[digit] + 1
            od

            if (0::9) |> all(digit => held[digit] == wanted[digit]) then
                yield total
            fi
        fi
    od
si

for width in 3::9 do
    let found = own_sums(width) |> collect_list()

    found.sort()

    write_line("{width} digits: {found |> map(v => "{v}") |> join(" ")}")
od
